## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A surviving three-fascicle fragment (originally twenty *juan*) of a mid-Táng *jì* 記 sub-commentary on **Dàoxuān**'s ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)) *Sìfēnlǜ shānfán bǔquē xíngshì chāo* 四分律刪繁補闕行事鈔 ([KR6k0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0017)) by the Sūzhōu Vinaya master **Zhìhóng** 志鴻 ([志鴻](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BF%97%E9%B4%BB)) of Shuānglínsì 雙林寺. The work programmatically collects and digests the *jì* and *chāo* of more than forty earlier exegetes — including *Dàcí* [大慈](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A7%E6%85%88), *Língè* [靈崿](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9D%88%E5%B4%BF), and others of the post-Dàoxuān generation — and is invaluable for the reconstruction of pre-Sòng *Nánshān* Vinaya scholarship.

**Abstract**

The *Sōuxuán lù* is the principal mid-Táng *Nánshān* sub-commentary surviving in fragmentary form and is the chief witness to the diversity of post-Dàoxuān Vinaya exegesis between the second-half of the seventh century and the late eighth. Chéngguān's preface confirms not only the date but the breadth of Zhìhóng's reading; the preserved fragments are a critical resource for identifying lost Tang *jì* writers. Zhìhóng died at the age of one hundred and eight (per the DILA biographical authority); his composition window must precede that and is fixed here by Chéngguān's *Dàlì* preface.
